By cycling through these blocks, the gardener adds height at a rate of $9/M$ per block per round. The lumberjack can remove at most 4 units of height per round in total. The lumberjack can prevent height growth in at most $4 / (9/M) = 4M/9$ blocks. The remaining $5M/9$ blocks will have a net height increase, and as shown by simulation, all 9 trees in such a block will eventually reach any height. Thus, the gardener can ensure $9 \times (5M/9) = 5M = 5 \times 675^2 = 2278125$ majestic trees.
